about_the_game:
Are there ever enough pockets in your life?

Ever fallen in love with a dress, only to realize, heartbreakingly, that it has no pockets?
Remember those pants with pockets so tiny, they couldn’t hold anything, not even a hair tie?

Yeah. We’ve all been there.

This is the place to talk about POCKETS, and why we still don't have them.

"Where Is My Pocket?" is an interactive story that humorously explores the strange and surprisingly political world of pocket inequality. Through playful narration, quirky characters, and colorful voxel art, the game invites you to laugh, learn, and maybe even question your wardrobe choices along the way.

Key Features:

  • Interview a cast of fictional characters, each with their own take on pocket injustice

  • Discover the contents of 10 random pockets

  • Embark on a pocket quest to find out what kind of pocket you'd have in an alternate universe

  • Learn how to sew a functional, realistic pocket 

  • Test your survival skills. How long can you last in a pocketless adventure?

  • Share your opinion on pockets in the optional end-game survey, your voice might appear in future updates!

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a fictional narrative about pocket inequality, told through a blend of humor, facts, and storytelling. While the core subject is not inherently mature, the game does include references to real-world topics such as gender roles, women's rights, and social inequality.
